note: Predicted signatures locked before the C3 sweep (Desert Map A2 discipline). All claims are sampler-relative (S1 constructive-saturation DAG, S2 DPLL tree-resolution). A changed prediction is a new prereg version, not an edit.

hardness_direction.convention: Refutation hardness increases as α DECREASES toward the ~4.267 sat threshold (Desert Map correction).

hypotheses.H1_plurality: Independent sampler runs produce structurally distinct refutations (median pairwise Jaccard well below 0.95); the refutation set is plural.

H2_geometry_as_alpha_to_threshold.length: Proof length distribution lengthens and its variance grows.
H2_geometry_as_alpha_to_threshold.overlap_Pq: P(q) shape shifts (possible multi-modal structure); direction TBD but must match across samplers.
H2_geometry_as_alpha_to_threshold.backbone: Backbone strengthens — more clause-ids at high frequency (the contradiction localizes).

hypotheses.H3_replication: Judged on TRENDS (direction/shape of each metric across the α sweep), NOT levels (R1). S2 (tree) and S1 (DAG) differ in levels by construction (S2 proofs systematically longer, larger backbone) — that level gap is the province-separation FINDING, not an artifact.

claim_standard.concordance: A geometry claim requires S1-vs-S2 agreement on the TREND direction/shape across α, beyond the S1-vs-S1 glitch (noise) bound. Level agreement is neither expected nor required.
claim_standard.province_separation: Reported as an exploratory finding (inter- vs intra-sampler overlap), never treated as an artifact.

controls.planted_core_backbone: On planted instances the backbone must identify the core clauses at ~100% (calibration standard) — verified in C1 for both samplers (min_core_freq = 1.0).
controls.glitch_S1_vs_S1: Two independent S1 seed banks bound sampler noise per metric before any S1-vs-S2 trend is read.

kill_thresholds.no_plurality: median pairwise Jaccard > 0.95 across cells (both samplers) -> effective proof uniqueness; write up and stop.
kill_thresholds.sampler_dominance: trend-level agreement fails on EVERY metric (S1 and S2 disagree on direction/shape of every α-trend beyond the glitch bound) -> geometry is artifact; stop.
kill_thresholds.compute: CPU-only; 12 h attention ceiling; $20 batch-CPU ceiling.
